Title: 11.1 Cooking range (1)
Description: Learn the working principles, internal heating element connections, and safety controls of modern domestic cooking ranges, tailored for 1st-year students in the Electrician Trade.

Title: 11.1 Pump Set (2)
Description: Learn the installation, wiring connections, and operational principles of single-phase and three-phase water pump sets, tailored for 1st-year students in the Electrician Trade.

Title: 11.1Electrical Cattle (3)
Description: Learn the heating element construction, automatic cutoff mechanism, and fundamental repair steps for an electric kettle, tailored for 1st-year students in the Electrician Trade.

Title: 11.2 Induction heater
Description: Learn the electromagnetic induction principles, internal circuit layouts, and fault troubleshooting steps for domestic induction heaters, tailored for 1st-year students in the Electrician Trade.

Title: 11.3 Food Mixer
Description: Learn the internal wiring, universal motor operation, and speed control mechanisms of a domestic food mixer, tailored for 1st-year students in the Electrician Trade.

Title: 11.4 Classification of Transformer (1)
Description: Understand the core classifications of transformers based on core construction, voltage ratios, and applications, tailored for 1st-year students in the Electrician Trade.

Title: 11.4 Autotransformer (2)
Description: Learn the working principles, single-winding construction, and voltage-regulation applications of an autotransformer, tailored for 1st-year students in the Electrician Trade.
